metadata.method: Independent Decimal(precision=60) + zoneinfo reference; each point recomputes sum(price*volume)/sum(volume) over all session bars up to that bar; no Welford, no TypeScript logic
metadata.tolerance: 1e-9 relative for vwap and cumVolume; exact for frozen and source
metadata.nanEncoding: NaN se serializa como la cadena "NaN"
metadata.nullVwMeaning: vw null equivale a vw ausente
